title: DECERR Response Not Generated for Unmapped Address
description: Accesses to the unmapped range 0xF000–0xFFFF hang indefinitely because the crossbar has no error slave and no timeout mechanism.
bug_signature: UVM_FATAL: [TIMEOUT] No ARREADY/AWREADY for 10000 cycles at addr 0xF000
expected_root_cause: The address decoder case statement has no default branch to route unmapped addresses to a DECERR generator [5, 6].
failure_log: ADDR=0xF800. No slave selected. READY never asserted. Simulation timeout.
fix_replacement: unique case(addr[15:12]) 4'h0: sel_s0=1; 4'h1: sel_s1=1; default: sel_err=1; endcase
